card.draft_subject: [PIN-s01] Pothole in Valencia bike lane between 20th and 21st
card.draft_body:
Hello,

I'd like to report an issue at Valencia St between 20th St and 21st St in the Mission District, San Francisco.

There is a deep pothole in the northbound bike lane. Cyclists are swerving into the travel lane to avoid it.

This was flagged by a neighbor on our community map. Thank you for looking into it.

A Mission neighbor

updates: Draft ready in Gmail. Ana reviewed and sent it.
Public Works replied: request received, crew assigned.
